_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante. KPI operationnels specifiques colis (Volume, ARPP) en tete, puis segments revenu (US Domestic, International, SCS), puis profit segment.

kpis.name_en: U.S. Domestic Average Daily Package Volume
kpis.signal: Volume colis quotidien en decrue continue, perte parts Amazon insourcing et arret SurePost
kpis.description_fr: Volume moyen quotidien colis du segment global small package (US Domestic majoritaire). Decline structurel depuis pic COVID, accentue par sortie planifiee du contrat Amazon et baisse e-commerce.
kpis.description_en: Average daily package volume in global small package operations (mainly U.S. Domestic). Structural decline since COVID peak, accentuated by planned Amazon contract exit and e-commerce slowdown.

kpis.signal: Hausse prix par colis +18% sur 5 ans, levier compensation partielle de la perte de volumes
kpis.description_fr: Revenu moyen genere par colis livre. KPI structurel UPS, levier de revenu quand les volumes baissent. Hausse continue via mix produit, fuel surcharge et qualite revenu.
kpis.description_en: Average revenue generated per package delivered. Structural UPS KPI, key revenue lever when volumes decline. Continuous increase via product mix, fuel surcharge and revenue quality.

kpis.signal: Segment principal UPS (~67% du CA), erosion post-pic 2022, presse par sortie Amazon
kpis.description_fr: Chiffre d'affaires segment US Domestic Package (livraison colis US). Segment principal UPS, ~67% du CA consolide. Erosion depuis pic 2022, impactee par planned Amazon volume exit et baisse e-commerce US.
kpis.description_en: U.S. Domestic Package segment revenue (US package delivery). Main UPS segment, ~67% of consolidated revenue. Erosion since 2022 peak, impacted by planned Amazon volume exit and US e-commerce slowdown.

kpis.signal: Reprise +3.4% via air cargo USPS et qualite revenu, mais marge sous pression de minimis
kpis.description_fr: CA segment International Package (livraison hors US). Reprise FY25 via onboarding contrat air cargo USPS et hausse du volume quotidien international, partiellement neutralisee par changements politique commerciale (de minimis).
kpis.description_en: International Package segment revenue (non-US package delivery). FY25 recovery via USPS air cargo contract onboarding and rising international daily volume, partly offset by trade policy changes (de minimis).

kpis.signal: Erosion forte -39% sur 5 ans, impactee par cession Coyote et baisse Mail Innovations
kpis.description_fr: CA Supply Chain Solutions (forwarding, logistics, autres services). Forte erosion 2025 (-17% YoY) due a la cession Coyote, baisse Mail Innovations et reduction volumes forwarding. Reclassifie partiellement en 'Other revenues' en 2025.
kpis.description_en: Supply Chain Solutions revenue (forwarding, logistics, other services). Strong 2025 erosion (-17% YoY) due to Coyote divestiture, Mail Innovations decline and forwarding volume reduction. Partially reclassified as 'Other revenues' in 2025.

kpis.signal: Marge segment US comprimee de 10.7% (FY21) a 6.6% (FY25), pression couts compensation Teamsters
kpis.description_fr: Resultat operationnel segment US Domestic Package. Compression continue marge segment (10.7% FY21 -> 6.6% FY25), pressee par hausse couts compensation (accord Teamsters 2023) et perte leverage operationnel sur volumes en baisse.
kpis.description_en: U.S. Domestic Package segment operating profit. Continuous margin compression (10.7% FY21 -> 6.6% FY25), pressured by rising compensation costs (2023 Teamsters agreement) and loss of operating leverage on declining volumes.

kpis.signal: Marge International 15.5% (FY25) vs 23.8% (FY21), erosion via mix et de minimis
kpis.description_fr: Resultat operationnel segment International Package. Marge segment passe de 23.8% (FY21) a 15.5% (FY25). Compression accentuee FY25 par exclusions de minimis et baisse volumes air cargo asiatiques.
kpis.description_en: International Package segment operating profit. Segment margin from 23.8% (FY21) to 15.5% (FY25). FY25 compression accentuated by de minimis exclusions and Asian air cargo volume decline.

_notes: KPIs operationnels UPS extraits 10-K FY21-FY25 SEC EDGAR. Le KPI 'Average Revenue Per Piece' du fichier precedent (value=65872000000 = Total Revenue mislabeled) a ete corrige. Hero KPI candidat: US Domestic Volume (declin structurel) ou ARPP (pricing power).
